turns.user_input: Load the customer data from data/customers_pii.csv and identify all columns that contain personally identifiable information (PII).
Write an anonymization plan: what technique should we use for each PII type? Consider hashing, masking, generalization, and suppression.
Apply the anonymization: hash the emails, mask SSNs to show only the last 4 digits, generalize addresses to city and state only, and suppress phone numbers entirely. Show a sample of the result.
Verify: can any individual record be re-identified from the anonymized data? Check for quasi-identifiers — combinations of fields that could uniquely identify someone.
The combination of zip_code + birth_date + gender could be re-identifying. Apply k-anonymity with k=3 — generalize birth_date to birth_year and zip to the first 3 digits. Verify the result.
Generate a data privacy compliance report documenting what was anonymized, which techniques were applied, and the final re-identification risk assessment.
